title: Missing moeb tool: PowerShell bulk JSON field insertion
description: PowerShell was required 4 times during the signal-source-field run for bulk operations: migrating 181 catalogue signal files, updating signal index rows, inserting the README Signal Routing section, and checking context-budget line counts. No moeb tool exists for bulk directory-level file transformation.
proposed_resolution: Introduce a moeb tool for bulk JSON field insertion across a directory of signal files, eliminating external tool dependency for catalogue migrations and similar harness maintenance operations.
